dashboard.label: Rainfall Totals
dashboard.description: Precipitation is rainfall during each 15-minute interval, in the logger's units. Daily, weekly, monthly, and annual charts sum those samples by logger_day (the date in datetime). The time picker applies to the 15-minute chart and the interval table. The total charts use their own calendar windows.

search.query: `zentra_weather_search` | stats count by device_sn | sort device_sn

single.title: Rain this period (sum of 15-minute samples)

search.query: | stats sum(value) as rainfall latest(units) as units | eval value = if(isnotnull(rainfall), round(rainfall, 3)." ".coalesce(units,""), "n/a") | fields value

single.option: not a single ZENTRA chart point — this is accumulated rainfall

single.title: Rain today (logger calendar)

search.query: `zentra_interval_precip` device_sn="$device_sn$" | where logger_day=strftime(now(), "%Y-%m-%d") | stats sum(value) as rainfall latest(units) as units | eval value = if(isnotnull(rainfall), round(rainfall, 3)." ".coalesce(units,""), "n/a") | fields value

single.option: sum of Precipitation where logger_day is today

single.title: Rain this week (logger calendar)

search.query: `zentra_interval_precip` device_sn="$device_sn$" | eval day_epoch=strptime(logger_day." 12:00:00", "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | where relative_time(day_epoch, "@w")=relative_time(now(), "@w") | stats sum(value) as rainfall latest(units) as units | eval value = if(isnotnull(rainfall), round(rainfall, 3)." ".coalesce(units,""), "n/a") | fields value

single.option: Sunday-start week, same buckets as the weekly chart

single.title: Rain this month (logger calendar)

search.query: `zentra_interval_precip` device_sn="$device_sn$" | where logger_day>=strftime(relative_time(now(), "@mon"), "%Y-%m-%d") | stats sum(value) as rainfall latest(units) as units | eval value = if(isnotnull(rainfall), round(rainfall, 3)." ".coalesce(units,""), "n/a") | fields value

single.option: sum of Precipitation for this calendar month

search.query: `zentra_interval_precip` device_sn="$device_sn$" | where logger_day>=strftime(relative_time(now(), "@y"), "%Y-%m-%d") | stats sum(value) as rainfall latest(units) as units | eval value = if(isnotnull(rainfall), round(rainfall, 3)." ".coalesce(units,""), "n/a") | fields value
`zentra_precip_rain` device_sn="$device_sn$" | table datetime, logger_day, value, units | sort - datetime

`zentra_interval_precip` device_sn="$device_sn$" | eval _time=strptime(logger_day." 12:00:00", "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | timechart span=1d sum(value) as daily_rainfall | eval daily_rainfall=if(daily_rainfall>0, round(daily_rainfall, 2), null())

`zentra_interval_precip` device_sn="$device_sn$" | eval _time=strptime(logger_day." 12:00:00", "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | timechart span=1w sum(value) as weekly_rainfall | where isnotnull(weekly_rainfall) | eval weekly_rainfall=round(weekly_rainfall, 2)

`zentra_interval_precip` device_sn="$device_sn$" | eval _time=strptime(logger_day." 12:00:00", "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | timechart span=1mon sum(value) as monthly_rainfall | where isnotnull(monthly_rainfall) | eval monthly_rainfall=round(monthly_rainfall, 2)

`zentra_interval_precip` device_sn="$device_sn$" | eval _time=strptime(logger_day." 12:00:00", "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | timechart span=1y sum(value) as annual_rainfall | where isnotnull(annual_rainfall) | eval annual_rainfall=round(annual_rainfall, 2)

table.title: Daily rainfall table — sum Precipitation by logger_day

search.query: | stats sum(value) as rainfall latest(units) as units count as interval_samples sum(eval(if(value>0,1,0))) as wet_intervals by logger_day, device_sn | eval rainfall=round(rainfall, 3) | sort - logger_day | rename logger_day as day, rainfall as rainfall_total
